summary: McCormick & Co. filed an 8-K regarding a Term Loan Agreement for up to $2.0 billion to finance its pending combination with Unilever's foods business via a merger agreement dated March 31, 2026. The term loan bears floating interest (Term SOFR + 0.750%-1.500% or Base Rate + 0.000%-0.500%) and matures three years post-close; it includes a 3.75x interest coverage covenant. Citibank is administrative agent. The ticking fee of 0.10% starts July 29, 2026. Watch for regulatory approvals and merger closing conditions; risk-arb spread hinges on deal certainty and financing terms.
